title: Developer Cold Iron Studios shuts down cloud version of $60 game with no refunds
summary: Following its announcement in March, game developer Cold Iron Studios has shut down the servers for the cloud version of Aliens: Fireteam Elite on the Nintendo Switch . The game will be accessible until August 5, 2026, 23:59 JST.
